data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. This issue is often related to the v4.2 SSO token format change. Advise the admin to re-save their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console, which will re-generate the necessary internal certificates. If using Okta, verify the Application Sign On URL format and clear browser cache and cookies for affected users. [T-3948] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
